name: Yono Bakrie
bio:
Yono Bakrie is an Indonesian stand-up comedian and actor (Born in Samarinda, East Kalimantan, on June 22, 1992). Yono graduated from Muhammadiyah University of East Kalimantan with a degree in Management.

Before becoming a comedian, Yono worked as an employee at a pharmaceutical company. He then joined the Stand Up Indo Samarinda community and began developing his comedy skills.

Yono gained fame after winning the Stand Up Comedy Indonesia (SUCI) X competition. He successfully defeated Gautama with a narrow score and became the champion of SUCI X.
